text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egypt and the United States agree to do all they can to encourage resumption of peace talks. Presidential adviser Osama el-Baz, who is on a visit to the United States, says violence does not benefit anyone and that Israel must remove its reasons.
- Mubarak offers Eid al-Adha prayers at mosque in Abbasiya.
- Prime Minister Ganzouri in official talks in China today. He says Egypt's new investment law will be passed in two weeks' time.
- Cabinet to discuss next week with prime minister new budget and next five-year plan.
- Gulf War compensation to be distributed after Eid holiday.
- 59 Egyptians to return home from Zaire today.
- Head of chemicals industry says workers at eight loss-incurring companies can apply for early retirement.
- Fisherman strangles wife after she refused to make him Eid meal.
